name: Kapwing
summary: Browser-based video editor with AI subtitles, text-to-speech, repurposing and prompt-to-video.
description: Kapwing is an online video editor for creating, editing and repurposing content. It includes subtitles, speaker focus, audio cleanup, text-to-speech, a repurposing studio and generation of full video projects from a prompt. Teams can collaborate with brand kits. The Free plan includes 10 credits; Pro costs $16 per month billed annually with 1,000 credits, and Business $50 per month. The company states more than 30 million creators use it.

howToUse.title: Open Kapwing
howToUse.description: Open Kapwing and choose Start Editing, or sign in.

howToUse.title: Edit the video in the browser
howToUse.description: Use the online video editor for creating, editing, and repurposing content. Add subtitles, apply speaker focus, run audio cleanup, and generate speech with text-to-speech.

howToUse.title: Generate a project from a prompt
howToUse.description: Generate a full video project from a prompt, or open Repurpose Studio to turn one video into clips for other channels.

howToUse.title: Collaborate, then check credits
howToUse.description: Collaborate with a team using brand kits. Free includes 10 credits. Pro is $16 each month when billed annually and includes 1,000 credits. Business is $50 each month. Kapwing reports more than 30 million creators.

features_fr: Éditeur vidéo basé sur un navigateur avec sous-titres IA, synthèse vocale, réutilisation et invite à la vidéo.
Kapwing est un éditeur vidéo en ligne permettant de créer, d'éditer et de réutiliser du contenu.
Il comprend les sous-titres, la mise au point sur le haut-parleur, le nettoyage audio, la synthèse vocale, un studio de réutilisation et la génération de projets vidéo complets à partir d'une invite.
Les équipes peuvent collaborer avec des kits de marque.
